author: Twillion
name: GamePostProcess3D
description: A neutral 3D post-processing extension base for GDevelop 3D scenes. It keeps the proven renderer hook, fullscreen shader pass, target layer support, master opacity, and optional 2D overlay compositing from 3DCRT+, with CRT-specific shader controls removed so a game-specific look can be added cleanly.
shortDescription: Neutral 3D post-processing base with overlay support.

eventsFunctions.name: StartPostProcessEffect
eventsFunctions.description: Turn on the game's 3D post-processing render pass.

parameters.name: Layer3D
parameters.longDescription: Optional. If set, the effect only applies to this layer's 3D camera. Leave empty for all 3D rendering.

eventsFunctions.name: StopPostProcessEffect
eventsFunctions.description: Turn off the game's 3D post-processing render pass.

eventsFunctions.name: PostProcessEffectIsEnabled
eventsFunctions.description: Check if the 3D post-processing render pass is currently on.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.longDescription: Master strength. 0 = original image, 255 = full effect. Default: 255.

eventsFunctions.name: RenderOverlayLayer
eventsFunctions.fullName: Render a 2D layer through the effect
eventsFunctions.description: Composite a named 2D layer inside the 3D post-processing pass.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Render 2D layer _PARAM1_ through the 3D post-processing effect

parameters.name: OverlayLayer
parameters.description: 2D layer to render through the effect
parameters.longDescription: Put HUD or overlay elements on this layer when they should be composited inside the post-processing pass.

eventsFunctions.name: StopOverlayLayer
eventsFunctions.fullName: Stop rendering the 2D layer through the effect
eventsFunctions.description: Stop compositing the overlay layer through the 3D post-processing pass.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Stop rendering the 2D overlay layer through the 3D post-processing effect

eventsFunctions.name: SetOverlayOpacity
eventsFunctions.description: Set the overlay-only fade to _PARAM1_ (0 = hidden, 1 = full).

eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Attach to a manager object in your 3D scene. It installs the renderer hook, syncs the opacity, and optionally targets a specific 3D layer.
eventsBasedBehaviors.name: GamePostProcess3D

events.inlineCode: // Runtime library is declared in onFirstSceneLoaded; this behavior starts syncing on its first frame.

propertyDescriptors.label: Opacity (0-255)
propertyDescriptors.description: Master strength. 0 = original image, 255 = full effect.
propertyDescriptors.name: Opacity

propertyDescriptors.label: Target 3D layer
propertyDescriptors.description: Layer to apply the effect to. Empty = all 3D rendering.
propertyDescriptors.name: TargetLayer
